description: A React component file for rendering detailed recipe pages in a Next.js application. It includes server-side functions for static parameter generation and metadata creation, and a default async component for rendering recipe details.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static route parameters based on all recipe IDs for static site generation.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Creates dynamic page metadata including title, description, and open graph information based on the recipe ID.

methods.name: RecipeDetail
methods.description: A React server component that fetches and displays detailed information about a recipe.
